resolvedValidationFailure.observation: The first ordinary build retained 54 old dictionary-only HTML files, although the manifest selected 4,000 articles. Their source identities and manuscript metadata were valid.
resolvedValidationFailure.resolution: The build command now forces Astro regeneration. A clean forced build rendered every selected body; repeating the updated normal build against the preserved stale-output baseline also left zero missing manuscript bodies. The final full audit passed.
